phaseReports.summary: All phase-1 tasks completed successfully. Project scaffolding is in place with package.json (ESM, bin field, zero runtime deps), tsconfig.json (strict, noUncheckedIndexedAccess), vitest.config.ts, all shared types defined in src/types/diary.ts, module stubs for all 6 source files with correct exports, test fixtures for git log and diary month, and CLAUDE.md orientation file. TypeScript typecheck passes clean.
phaseReports.orchestratorAnalysis: Phase 1 completed cleanly. All 5 tasks passed acceptance criteria: package.json has type:module and bin field, tsconfig.json has strict:true and noUncheckedIndexedAccess:true, vitest.config.ts has v8 coverage, npm install succeeded, typecheck passes, all types defined with export type, all 6 source files exist with correct named exports and .js import extensions, no default exports, index.ts has shebang, fixtures contain required commit patterns. Ready to advance to phase-2 (core data pipeline).
correctiveTasks: phase-1-task-4: gitLog.txt fixture SHAs are now 39 characters instead of 40. Commit 1 SHA `abc1234567890abcdef1234567890abcdef1234` is 39 chars and commit 3 SHA `789abcdef1234567890abcdef1234567890abcd` is 39 chars. The fix removed 2 characters from each instead of 1. Spec §4 requires full 40-character SHAs. Fix by adding one hex character to each: e.g., `abc1234567890abcdef1234567890abcdef12345` and `789abcdef1234567890abcdef1234567890abcde`.
